dedupe_keys.name: knbs 2019 kenya population and housing census volume iv household water sanitation waste cooking and lighting fuel dwelling materials and ict use by county and sub county pdf

description: The Kenya National Bureau of Statistics publishes the results of the 2019 Kenya Population and Housing Census as report volumes and an atlas. Volume IV, on socio-economic characteristics, has 498 pages of tables by rural and urban area, county and sub-county, and is the most detailed public source for household services in Kenya. Its household tables give tenure; roofing, wall and floor materials; main source of drinking water; main mode of human waste disposal and of solid waste disposal; cooking fuel; and lighting fuel. Further tables cover mobile phone, internet and computer use, and farming households with irrigation and livestock. Coverage is national: of 12,043,016 conventional households, 50.4% used mains electricity as the main lighting source (26.3% rural, 88.4% urban) and 19.3% solar; 10.1% had water piped into the dwelling and 14.1% piped to the yard or plot. Format and access: free PDF downloads from the census page, no registration; atlas chapters on housing and ICT map the same variables. The KeNADA catalogue lists the census with its questionnaire and manuals but offers no microdata files. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: percentages, not counts, in the service tables; PDF tables need extraction. Simulation uses: sub-county service coverage for water, sanitation, waste and electricity access models, and dwelling materials for exposure. Related records: the WorldPop census based gridded population and the Ghana 2021 census microdata sample.
